criteria.name: agent_profiles
criteria.description: Each agent has distinct personality, tone, and quirk; profiles feel differentiated and coherent, not generic

criteria.name: skill_coverage
criteria.description: Each agent has 6-8 specific, role-appropriate skills; no obvious skill gaps or duplications across agents

criteria.name: model_justification
criteria.description: Model choices are justified with reasoning tied to agent needs (latency, reasoning depth, cost); both primary and fallback provided

criteria.name: routing_logic
criteria.description: Routing rules are specific and actionable; inter-agent handoffs are clearly defined

criteria.name: sample_workflow
criteria.description: Multi-agent workflow for the log analysis scenario correctly chains all 4 agents with clear handoffs
